title: Completed questions
body: Each chapter now shows how many questions you have answered correctly. New questions come first, and ones you have done before are marked “Done before”.

title: Biology question fixes
body: We repaired Biology questions that had missing statements, wrong figures or stray tags, and corrected the 2015 Q6 answer. Questions we could not recover were removed.

title: New: AI tutor
body: After you answer a question, tap “Ask AI about this” to get an explanation. It needs a free Google Gemini key, set up in about a minute.

title: Biology Semester 1 and 2 expanded
body: Chapters 1 to 14 now include many more past-year questions with figures. Chapters 8 and 9 are now in Semester 2.
